description: This file is a test script for the 'git patch-id' functionality, containing test cases and setup procedures for verifying the behavior of patch ID generation in Git. It runs various git commands, manipulates diffs, and checks outputs to ensure correct patch ID computation under different scenarios.

methods.name: calc_patch_id
methods.description: Calculates the patch ID for a given patch, outputs to a file, and verifies it contains exactly one line.

methods.name: get_top_diff
methods.description: Retrieves the top diff from the most recent commit against specified parameters.

methods.name: get_patch_id
methods.description: Combines getting the top diff and calculating the patch ID for a specific commit or reference.

methods.name: cmp_patch_id
methods.description: Compares two patch IDs, optionally expecting them to differ or be the same based on the argument.
